t: 让-皮埃尔·布兰查德成为美国第一个搭乘气球飞行的人.

dz: 第二次瓜分波兰.

te: The French troops led by Léger-Félicité Sonthonax defeat the slaves settlers in the Siege of Port-au-Prince.

te: François Hanriot, leader of the Parisian National Guard, arrests 22 Girondists selected by Jean-Paul Marat, setting the…
dz: 法国大革命：巴黎国民警卫队领导人弗朗索瓦·汉里奥逮捕了让·保罗·马拉挑选的 22 名吉伦特派分子，为恐怖统治奠定了基础。
de: French Revolution: François Hanriot, leader of the Parisian National Guard, arrests 22 Girondists selected by Jean-Paul Marat, setting the stage for the Reign of Terror.

de: French Revolution: Following the arrests of Girondin leaders, the Jacobins gain control of the Committee of Public Safety installing the revolutionary dictatorship.

te: The Jardin des Plantes museum opens in Paris. A year later, it becomes the first public zoo.
dz: Jardin des Plantes博物馆在巴黎开幕. 一年后,它成为了第一个公共动物园.

dz: 普鲁士王国从法国手中重新征服美因茨。

dz: 法国革命战争：土伦市反抗法兰西共和国，并允许英国和西班牙舰队占领其港口，导致法国革命军队围攻土伦。
de: French Revolutionary Wars: The city of Toulon revolts against the French Republic and admits the British and Spanish fleets to seize its port, leading to the Siege of Toulon by French Revolutionary forces.
